verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1680). Measures the consequence in-process: imports lib/events/series.ts (zero imports, type-stripped) and runs it on a weekly series of five dates plus a one-off. Under a popularity comparator the series is represented by its best-attended date and keeps its five dates earliest-first, and a tie elects the earliest (SERIES-RANK); a three-card series maps to ONE pin carrying its four other dates (SERIES-PIN); groupBySeries keeps every date under the series title, earliest first, and leaves the one-off alone (SERIES-PICKER). Then reads the wiring on comment-free source: /events elects with and sorts by one comparator and builds its map through onePerSeries, the map popup calls moreDatesLine, /admin/qr selects parent_event_id, groups with groupBySeries and renders an optgroup, and the circle picker selects parent_event_id and groups. It also holds the two rulings: no layout module or default layout names event-series-dates and the page renders SeriesDatesRail in the seriesRail slot (SERIES-MAIN); the embeddings backfill keys on seriesKey, never reads anchors only, and embedEvent has no date gate (SERIES-EMBED). Fails on main (30975a1b0) at the first arm: series.ts exports no onePerSeries. SERIES-PD (needs a migration) is not measured here; it leaves this row. Exits 1 naming the file when a wired file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1680). Each tag re-tested against main at 30975a1b0 (ADR-1082). BUILT, three: SERIES-RANK (collapseSeries takes elect as a comparator; /events lifts its sort into compareEvents and elects with it under Nearest, Most going and Best match, so a series ranks on its best date, ties elect the earliest, and soonest-first still elects the next date), SERIES-PIN (the /events map was built row by row from a card list carrying up to three dates of one series, stacking pins on one venue; onePerSeries now draws one pin per series and the popup says "and N more dates" with the /nearby copy and bubble), SERIES-PICKER (groupBySeries keeps every date and heads a series' dates with its title: /admin/qr listed a daily series as up to 61 identical bare titles and now lists dates under an optgroup, one-offs read "Title · date"; the circle Manage "Add an event" picker groups the same way). RULED, two, with the evidence in docs/EVENTS-SERIES-BUILD-PLAN.md: SERIES-MAIN is moot (the rail never became the event-series-dates layout module; SeriesDatesRail renders in the seriesRail slot of EventDetailTemplate, which no saved layout can move), and SERIES-EMBED was closed by what shipped (the backfill reaches an aged-out anchor through its upcoming children and keys on seriesKey; updateEvent and writeEventCopy re-embed through embedEvent, which has no date gate). LEFT, one: SERIES-PD (a DISTINCT ON push-down so a LIMIT counts series) needs a functional index and an RPC or view per surface, which is a migration this row does not write. It leaves this row for its own, filed by the owner; nothing else is filed here. No migration.
